name: ImageViewer
description: One image, or a before/after pair, full screen on Modal's dark scrim, zoomed by the image itself (pinch, double tap, pan, wheel, keys) while the page stays put.
usage: `open` and `onClose` (controlled), and either `src` + `alt` (one image) or `compare` (two `{ label, src }`, before then after, shown in ImageCompare's slider). `label` names the dialog (default: `alt`, or "<before> and <after>").

Opens on `Modal scrim="dark" bare`: the image fitted inside the safe-area insets (1rem at least) and centred, a ✕ top right. A tap outside the image, the ✕ or Escape closes; focus returns to what opened it.

Open it over a dialog (a card's thumbnail): it sits on top, and Escape or closing goes back to that dialog. Render it after the dialog opens (on the thumbnail's tap), so its portal lands after the dialog's.

Gestures: two fingers pinch around their midpoint (and pan as it moves); a double tap on the image toggles 1x and 2.5x around the tap; one finger pans when zoomed. Always 1x-5x, and a zoomed image's edges never come inside the screen on a side it overflows. Closing resets it.
Mouse: the wheel, or ctrl+wheel (a trackpad's pinch), zooms around the cursor; a drag pans when zoomed; a double click toggles.
Keys: + (or =) and - zoom around the centre, 0 resets, the arrows pan when zoomed.

A pair: the handle drags only from itself (a 44px strip along its line) or with its keys; a drag anywhere else pans when zoomed. Both images zoom and pan together; the handle stays where it is on screen and the reveal follows.
The page's own zoom is the app's to lock (a Home Screen app, Ringmaster's board); the viewer's surface takes every touch on it (touch-action: none), so a pinch on the image never zooms the page.
design: The scrim is Modal's dark one (--color-surface-0 at 90 %, no backdrop-filter); no card: the image sits straight on it, --radius-md on a single image.
The ✕: a secondary icon Button, 44px round, top right inside the safe area (--spacing-xs at least).

Motion: double tap, keys and reset ease the transform (--duration-shift, --ease-spring-out); pinch, pan and the wheel follow the input with no transition; Modal's fade (fadeIn) opens and closes it. Under Reduce Motion nothing eases.
A pair: ImageCompare's slider with its `zoom`: no frame, the labels at the visible image's bottom corners (the ✕ takes the top right).
accessibility: A modal dialog (Modal: role="dialog", aria-modal, focus trap, top-only Escape, focus returned on close), named by `label`, `alt` or the pair's labels.
Focus goes to the zoom surface on open, so + / - / 0 and the arrows work at once; a visually hidden hint (aria-describedby) says how to zoom.
The ✕ is a named button ("Close"); a pair's handle keeps ImageCompare's slider role, name, value and keys.
Every gesture has a key: zoom (+ / -), reset (0), pan (arrows).

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on a tap outside the image, the ✕ or Escape.

props.name: alt
props.description: The image's alt text, and the dialog's name unless `label` is given.

props.name: compare
props.description: A before/after pair instead of `src`, shown in ImageCompare's slider.

props.name: label
props.description: The dialog's accessible name; defaults to `alt`, or "<before> and <after>".
